title: OpenAI Hires New Chief Revenue Officer Amid Executive Shake-Up
summary: OpenAI has appointed Dali Rajic, former president and COO of Wiz (acquired by Google for $32 billion), as its new Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), replacing Denise Dresser after nine months. This move is part of a broader executive restructuring following the departures of COO Brad Lightcap and AGI deployment CEO Fidji Simo. OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman highlighted Rajic's role in scaling revenue execution as the company focuses on enterprise deployment and measurable business impact. OpenAI serves over 1 billion weekly active users and 2 million businesses but has faced challenges in meeting revenue goals. The company has filed confidentially for a potential IPO and conducted a $7 billion tender offer for employee shares, possibly indicating a delayed public debut.
key_points: OpenAI replaces CRO Denise Dresser with Dali Rajic, former Wiz president and COO.
Rajic’s appointment is part of a broader executive shake-up, including the departures of COO Brad Lightcap and AGI deployment CEO Fidji Simo.
Greg Brockman, OpenAI co-founder, emphasizes Rajic’s role in scaling revenue execution for enterprise deployment.
OpenAI serves over 1 billion weekly active users and 2 million businesses but has not met all revenue targets.
The company has filed confidentially for a potential IPO and conducted a $7 billion tender offer for employee shares.
CEO Sam Altman has shifted focus toward enterprise deployment, reducing experimental projects.
